description: An eighth of the way from the top, a grey wave with four peaks and three valleys, filled in to the top with color. An eighth of the way from the bottom, a block of grey color covers the paper. A vertical rectangle in the shape of a door, with a single line outlining the door. In the block of color on the bottom, a darker shade appears to be a door mat. This artwork is on the back of *Untitled (Patio Door)*, 1970s (cat. no. 1687).
